zh-CN.title: 聊天气泡不再只是换一种颜色
items: 下架十二款缺少结构辨识度的气泡，把候选库收敛到真正有设计差异的十六款
打字机、报纸、票据、终端、全息、机械、贴纸与积木均获得独立轮廓和排版语言
预览与真实聊天统一由外层气泡承载皮肤，音频、文件、位置、足迹和链接不再冒出默认白卡

en.title: Chat bubbles are more than color swaps
items: Twelve low-identity bubbles have been retired, focusing the library on sixteen genuinely distinct designs
Typewriter, Newspaper, Receipt, Terminal, Hologram, Mechanical, Sticker, and Toy Brick now have unique silhouettes and typography
Preview and live chat share one outer bubble skin, preventing audio, files, locations, travel maps, and links from reverting to white cards
